actions.script: const on = String(takeXmppLocation ?? '') === 'true' ec.service.sync().name('org.moqui.maps.LocationServices.update#Share').parameters({shareId: String(shareId ?? ''), takeXmppLocation: on ? 'true' : 'false'}).requireNewTransaction(true).call() if (!ec.message.hasError()) ec.message.addMessage(ec.l10n.localize(on ? 'Your XMPP app\'s location now goes to your XMPP contacts' : 'Your XMPP app\'s location no longer goes to your XMPP contacts'), 'success')
